$comment: The TSL IR op vocabulary: every op name packages/blender-addon/tsl_ir.py may emit and packages/blendlink/src/tslNodeRecipe.ts must build. Both sides assert their own set against this file, so an op added on one side of the language gap fails in milliseconds instead of surviving until a Blender e2e happens to exercise it. This is the same contract conformance/vocabulary.json holds for the node vocabulary, for the same measured reason: hand-mirrored parsers drift. Numeric fidelity per op is a separate proof and belongs to experiments/tsl-node-differential.
